tasks.label: Build KIM paper tape
tasks.command: mkdir -p build && ca65 --cpu 6502 -I Programs -l "$B.lst" -o "$B.o" "${relativeFile}" && ld65 -C kim.cfg -o "$B.bin" "$B.o" && srec_cat "$B.bin" -binary -offset 0x0200 "$B.bin-fat.bin" -binary -offset 0x0400 "$B.bin-high.bin" -binary -offset 0x1780 "$B.bin-low.bin" -binary -offset 0x0100 "$B.bin-zp.bin" -binary -offset 0x0000 -o "$B.pap" -MOS_Technologies && rm -f "$B.lst" "$B.o" "$B.bin" "$B.bin-fat.bin" "$B.bin-high.bin" "$B.bin-low.bin" "$B.bin-zp.bin"
